about: Pitches from the FA26 equity research reports. Prices, dates, targets, case multiples and report financials are as written in each report; drivers come from SEC filings through auto-fill.

examples.label: MYRG: FA26 hold (22 Sep 2026)
examples.horizon_basis: Targets are year-end FY2028 (the report's PT path runs FY2026, FY2027, FY2028).
examples.source: FA26 MYRG equity research report, 22 Sep 2026: pitch details and Model Integration.
notes: Record backlog of $3.16B with roughly 72% expected to convert within a year (report, Risks to Thesis); the conversion P50 is set to 0.72, P10 and P90 are the app's defaults.

dcf_path.basis: FY2028E revenue $5,915M and EBITDA $350M from the report, at the base multiple; growth compounds from filed FY revenue $3,657.9M over 2.25 years, the engine's basis.

examples.label: CALM: FA26 buy (24 Sep 2026)
examples.horizon_basis: Targets are on FY2028E EBITDA; Cal-Maine's FY2028 ends around June 2028.

case_multiples.basis: EV/EBITDA on FY2028E, held constant in all cases

examples.source: FA26 CALM equity research report, 24 Sep 2026: pitch details, Valuation and Scenario Analysis.
notes: The report holds the multiple at 5.5x in every case, so its bear-to-bull spread is all egg prices, feed and volume. The simulation's multiple still varies over CALM's filed history.

dcf_path.basis: FY2028E revenue $3,259M and EBITDA $567M from the report, at the base multiple; growth compounds from filed FY revenue $2,911.6M over 1.75 years, the engine's basis.

examples.label: RAL: FA26 buy (17 Sep 2026)
examples.horizon_basis: Not stated. At 19.0x the base target implies about $615M of EBITDA, above the report's FY2027E $575M, so the targets sit on FY2028; year-end FY2028 is 2.25 years out.
examples.source: FA26 RAL equity research report, 17 Sep 2026: Valuation section.
notes: The report's pitch details box gives different targets ($89 base, $104 upside, $50 downside) from its Valuation section ($97.04, $114.22, $54.19); the Valuation figures are used because they match the stated +44%, +70% and -19% at $67.25 and carry the case multiples.
No base-case path: the report gives no FY2028 revenue or EBITDA.
